mode.description: What to debug: `run` runs `main`, `test` runs the file's tests.

program.description: The .nomi file to debug. In run mode, a directory names a project whose nomi.toml lists one entry point.

line.description: In test mode, debug only the test, `tests` group or `//!` attached test starting on this line, as `nomi test --line` selects it.

cwd.description: The working directory the program runs in.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the program.

console.description: Where the program's input and output go. Zed shows them in the debug console.

justMyCode.description: Step through the standard library's code without stopping in it.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program's first statement.
